title: Concrete restricted affine scheme and coefficient constructions
statement: For a scheme S, preorder I, diagram D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S, and etale U over S, construct the functor whose object at i is pullback U.hom (D.obj i).hom and whose map is rawAffineRestrictedMap of D.map f. Its cone for c has vertex pullback U.hom c.pt.hom and the analogous maps. Construct K as the single complex of each sheaf restricted along the second projection, G as restriction of H reindexed by double opposite followed by the single functor, and L as the image of the whiskered coefficient colimit cocone. These are actual constructions, not chosen witnesses. The accompanying proved declarations show: the cone is limiting when the underlying cone c is; stages are compact and quasi-separated when their morphisms to S are qcqs and U is affine; transitions are affine when those of D are; and L is colimiting because restriction and the single functor preserve colimits.

proof.text: Construct the diagram and cone with pullback.map and prove their functoriality and naturality by pullback.hom_ext. Transport the preserved limit of Over.pullback U.hom followed by Over.forget U.left through pullbackSymmetry. The over-category forgetful functor preserves and reflects connected limits; I is connected because it is nonempty and directed.

The first projection to affine U is the base change of the given qcqs structure morphism, so its source is compact and quasi-separated. Each transition is a pullback.map of an affine morphism and therefore affine by MorphismProperty.pullbackMap.

Construct K with singleFunctor of the inverse image along the second projection, and G with double-opposite reindexing followed by restriction and singleFunctor. Construct L as the image of the whiskered actual colimit cocone. Restriction is a left adjoint and singleFunctor preserves colimits; unopUnop is final, so isColimitOfPreserves and Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv prove L colimiting.
